verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents its own automatic categorization of imported transactions: up to 98% auto-categorization, 98% categorized with Brex, and an 'ask AI' button for categorizing a transaction. Nothing in the evidence shows the system learning from user corrections. User-created custom rules are a manual control, not adaptive learning, so they earn no credit for that part. missing for 10: evidence that categorization suggestions learn from or adapt to user corrections, detail on how suggestions are presented and reviewed for imported transactions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get automatic categorization suggestions for imported transactions that learn from my corrections

citations.quote: 98% transactions categorized When you connect Brex with Puzzle
A user can click on a button and “ask AI” for help in categorizing a transaction
